name: Toon
source:
Main character has to take supplementary lessons alone during summer vacation as a result of traffic accident. However, childhood friend comes to visit him secretly feeling partial guild for the traffic accident. With a cute teacher and a childhood friend like that summer may still bring joy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公因交通事故，暑假不得不独自补课。然而，可能是对事故心怀愧疚，青梅竹马偷偷来看望他。有可爱的老师和这样的青梅竹马陪伴，这个夏天或许依然会很快乐。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
